high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @IndianTechGuide, which is verified. The tweet announces that Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) will begin assembling its premium vehicles at a new facility in Tamil Nadu by early 2026, with an investment of Rs 9,000 crore over five years. The tweet includes two images: The first image shows the logo of Jaguar Land Rover on a building. The logo features the iconic leaping jaguar above the words "JAGUAR" and "LAND ROVER" in a black oval. The second image is a photograph
